acceptance.description: Produce an implementation-ready browser-to-bridge contract with browser-valid request-class rules, exact endpoint policies, and mandatory preview-origin separation consistent with approved architecture.
Specify measurable bootstrap/capability states, limits, expiry, revocation, transport and leak exclusions, with explicit same-device residual risks.
Provide positive/negative verification cases for request classes, lifecycle and preview boundary, and distinguish design claims from runtime/browser evidence.
